title: Cloud File Storage
definition: Storing user-uploaded files directly on your Node.js server (like the EC2 instance) is an anti-pattern because if the server scales or crashes, the files are lost. Instead, you should upload files directly to cloud storage like AWS S3 or Google Cloud Storage.

answers.question: Define Cloud File Storage in your own words.
answers.answer: Storing user-uploaded files directly on your Node.js server (like the EC2 instance) is an anti-pattern because if the server scales or crashes, the files are lost.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Cloud File Storage?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
